data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (From/To, date, Passengers/Class with Confirm, Show flights, Select fare) in the right order with the right core parameters, but it adds an unobserved "One way" step, restricts cabin to Economy/Premium, and is vague on the fare selection, though a browser automation could still be built from it.
